description.value: L'aromas Coffee Terra Nova is the Richmond outpost of a locally-founded, independently-owned BC coffee roasting company established in 2015 by three friends who started with a coffee trailer at community markets. The brand has grown to four distinct café locations, each rooted in a neighbourhood identity, with a focus on quality espresso and in-house baked goods. Cyclists passing through Richmond's Terra Nova area will find a sit-down café environment with an online ordering option and a loyalty rewards program.
